Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished comparison concept board for the Russian mobile app Divergents, specifically Reading challenge. Portrait image 1024x1536. This is a professional UI design presentation, NOT a poster or phone photograph. Show exactly TWO large mobile-width UI block designs stacked vertically with lots of breathing room, on a very pale cool grey presentation background. Top block is a LIGHT THEME community entry card; bottom block is a DARK THEME expanded Reading challenge header with one short team/applications navigation row under it. Board margin 48px; both specimens same width. No phone hardware, no invented logo, no section numbering, no ornamental labels outside specimens. User explicitly rejects large flat colored rectangles, generic flat book icon in colored tile, loud gradients, and repetitive pill badges. Wants premium quiet minimalism with beautiful original illustrations. Preserve Divergents brand navy #234088, blue #3D5BDB and pale blue #8AA0FF only as restrained accents, cool white and graphite surfaces. Natural Russian readable type: subtly rounded geometric sans resembling Gotham Rounded, no ornate display serif, no tiny low-contrast labels, strong hierarchy, comfortably padded controls. One coherent authored illustration per specimen, integrated with negative space and not boxed in a generic icon tile.
Top light card contains exact text: "Reading challenge", "Время для книги", "60 минут в день · Без срока", and an understated arrow action "Открыть челлендж". Bottom dark expanded header contains exact text: "Reading challenge", "Talents lab — Reading", "Читаем каждый день. Без даты окончания.", then a restrained outlined action "Команды и заявки". No countdown, no progress, no fake member counts, no page totals, no prices, no 21 days, no invented features. Keep text separate from illustration and perfectly readable. Specimens should look implementable in native mobile UI, refined not marketing. Direction: "Тишина и бумага". Top block white unboxed breathing layout, left-aligned title with elegant compact text stack and right-aligned exquisite delicate navy ink engraving of an open book, with fine page detail and one satin blue ribbon bookmark. The book is a genuinely crafted editorial illustration, not a simple outline icon, no plants, no stars. Thin understated separating rule above bottom action. Expanded dark header has the same book illustration in cool silver-blue etched strokes occupying its upper right quadrant; title and supporting text left, generous negative space. Restrained, intimate, tactile and literary. Borders barely perceptible, corner radius restrained. No saturated blue panel.
